init_distributed_mode: init distributed training mode by reading env vars and starting the torch process group
create_metric_logger: create a MetricLogger to track and log smoothed training metrics like loss and accuracy over iterations
save_load_model: save or load a model checkpoint including optimizer state, epoch, and AMP scaler on the master process
use_smoothed_value: use a SmoothedValue to track running median, average, and max of a series of training metric values
all_gather_unaligned: all gather arbitrary picklable data across all GPU ranks in a distributed training job
